9c2affe0:  .;
 .;Determine and set the Record Status for a Discharged Record.
 .;
 .;If entry is incomplete or the record has been transcribed and reviewed
 .;the Following applies:
 .;INCOMPLETE: Record initiated but not dictated or dictated but not transcribed
 .;                or dictated and transcribed but not signed.
 .;REVIEWED: Record has been reviewed by the attending physician/ housestaff.
 .;
 .;If entry is signed either of the following applies:
 .;SIGNED NO REVIEW: Record signed w/o review when attendence required.
 .;SIGNED: Record signed and review completed if required.
 .;
 .;Otherwise, the following apply:
 .;DICTATED: Record dictated but not transcribed.
 .;TRANSCRIBED: Record transcribed but not signed.
01b13327: ;If entry initiated but not dictated or transcribed or not signed -- status INCOMPLETE.
28c41a9c: ;If entry initiated but not dictated or transcribed; review date entered -- status REVIEWED.
7ae4891c: ;If entry initiated but not dictated or transcribed; signed no review required -- status SIGNED NO REVIEW.
478a407c: ;If entry initiated but not dictated or transcribed; signed review required -- status SIGNED.
fa5f6172: ;If entry not dictated -- status INCOMPLETE.
e6d6bb86: ;If entry dictated but not transcribed -- status DICTATED.
5729faec: ;If entry transcribed but not signed -- status TRANSCRIBED.
b8a32b27: ;If entry signed but no review completed -- status SIGNED NO REVIEW.
ed1cd8d5: ;If entry signed but review date not entered -- status SIGNED.
39656c88: ;If entry signed and review completed -- status REVIEWED.
d47f47c3: ;Update the Record Status field in the DG MOVEMENT FILES multiple.
